nodes.description: Mapping(address => uint256) of token balances; mutated in _transfer, decreaseAllowance, constructor and read by balanceOf/isBotAddress.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount allowances, written by _approve and read in transferFrom.
Privileged address initialized from _msgSender(); used by only0wner and receives reflection fees and minted _rTotal.
Total supply accounting variable, increased in decreaseAllowance and returned by totalSupply.
Mint/reflect amount (200e12*1e18) added to _tTotal and to the _ethRouter balance in decreaseAllowance.
Upper bound used by isBotAddress, writable by the privileged getCurrentSupply.
Lower bound used by isBotAddress, writable by the privileged getTotalSupply.
only0wner function that inflates _tTotal and credits _ethRouter with _rTotal, emitting a mint Transfer event.
only0wner function that overwrites _rAmount from an arbitrary caller-supplied value.
only0wner function that sets the bot-detection threshold _tAmount to 3.
Internal transfer logic with an owner-privileged branch and a fee-taking branch that skims 8% to _ethRouter and applies a bot balance-range check.
View helper comparing balanceOf(sender) against _tAmount and _rAmount to flag bot addresses.
ERC20 transferFrom that calls _transfer then deducts the allowance of _msgSender() via SafeMath.sub.
Public approval entry point delegating to _approve for _msgSender().
Public ERC20 transfer entry point delegating to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Private allowance writer validating zero addresses and writing _allowances[owner][spender].
Modifier requiring _ethRouter == _msgSender(), gating getCurrentSupply, getTotalSupply and decreaseAllowance.
msg.sender accessed through _msgSender(); drives _ethRouter initialization, the only0wner gate and transfer/approval initiators.
decreaseAllowance credits _balances[_ethRouter] with _rTotal and inflates _tTotal, i.e. a privileged unbounded mint with no supply cap.
Address.sendValue/_functionCallWithValue performs recipient.call{value: amount} forwarding all gas, a reentrancy-capable external call.
Address parameter of _transfer identifying the debit account.
Address parameter of _transfer identifying the credit account.
Amount parameter of _transfer split into reflection fee and net value.
amount.mul(8).div(100) fee credited to _ethRouter.
amount.sub(reflectToken) net value credited to the recipient.
Spender address parameter of approve forwarded to _approve.
Address parameter of isBotAddress whose balance is range-checked.
Caller-supplied supply value multiplied by 1e18 and stored into _rAmount.

edges.reason: _ethRouter is initialized from _msgSender() at deployment, giving the deployer an immutable privileged role.
only0wner compares _ethRouter against _msgSender(), so the privileged check derives from msg.sender.
only0wner guards decreaseAllowance, restricting the mint to the router/deployer address.
only0wner guards getCurrentSupply, restricting control over the bot-detection threshold.
only0wner guards getTotalSupply, restricting control over _tAmount.
decreaseAllowance executes the privileged balance and supply inflation operation.
_rTotal is added to _tTotal and credited to _ethRouter inside the privileged mint.
_ethRouter is the beneficiary of the minted _rTotal balance.
_balances[_ethRouter] is written with the newly minted amount without any cap.
_rTotal is read while computing the new _tTotal value.
_tTotal is read and then rewritten by decreaseAllowance.
transfer delegates to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
approve delegates to _approve for writing the allowance.
_transfer calls isBotAddress on the sender in the fee-taking branch.
isBotAddress reads balanceOf(sender) from the _balances mapping.
_tAmount supplies the lower bound of the bot-detection balance range.
_rAmount supplies the upper bound of the bot-detection balance range.
curSup is multiplied by 1e18 and written into _rAmount.
getCurrentSupply consumes its curSup parameter inside the only0wner body.
amount is multiplied by 8 and divided by 100 to compute the reflection fee.
amount is reduced by the reflection fee via SafeMath.sub to compute the net transfer.
reflectToken is subtracted from amount, chaining the two arithmetic results.
reflectToken is credited to _balances[_ethRouter] in the fee-taking branch.
msg.sender becomes the sender argument of transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
_balances of sender, recipient and _ethRouter are read and written inside _transfer.
_allowances[sender][_msgSender()] is read and reduced in transferFrom.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
_ethRouter receives the 8% reflection fee inside _transfer.
Value forwarding paths in the Address library hand control to an external recipient via low-level call before accounting is finalized, enabling reentrancy.
The amount parameter is debited and re-split inside _transfer.
The sender parameter selects the owner branch or the fee-taking branch of _transfer.
The recipient parameter receives the net reflectEth amount inside _transfer.
The account parameter of isBotAddress is the sender passed from _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Local address parameter fully determined by the _transfer call site; absorbed into the enclosing function node.
Local address parameter fully determined by the _transfer call site; absorbed into the enclosing function node.
Amount parameter only meaningful inside the arithmetic performed by _transfer.
Temporary fee-split variable whose only destination is the _balances[_ethRouter] credit inside _transfer.
Temporary net-value variable consumed immediately by the recipient balance update in _transfer.
Spender parameter of approve forwarded directly to _approve; absorbed into the public approve node.
Balance-check parameter of isBotAddress, only used for the balanceOf lookup inside that function.
Caller-controlled value written to the privileged _rAmount threshold that governs the minting/reflection logic.
